children: UPM AND SAPPI SUBMIT REMEDIES IN EUROPEAN COMMISSION REVIEW OF PROPOSED GRAPHIC PAPER JOINT VENTURE
PROPOSED REMEDIES HAVE BEEN OFFERED TO SUPPORT ONGOING REVIEW PROCESS AND DO NOT CHANGE UPM'S VIEW THAT TRANSACTION DOES NOT RAISE COMPETITION CONCERNS
UPM CONTINUES TO BELIEVE THAT PLANNED JOINT VENTURE WOULD SUPPORT LONG-TERM COMPETITIVENESS, SUSTAINABILITY AND RESILIENCE OF EUROPEAN GRAPHIC PAPER INDUSTRY
EUROPEAN COMMISSION WILL NOW ASSESS PROPOSED REMEDIES AS PART OF ITS ONGOING REVIEW PROCESS
UPM AND SAPPI CONTINUE TO ENGAGE CONSTRUCTIVELY WITH COMMISSION
COMMISSION'S FINAL DECISION IS EXPECTED BY YEAR-END OR SHORTLY THEREAFTER
